summary: Neon fleet and branch-lifecycle commands (stale, tree, usage, wait, preview up, prune, compute audit) with safety contracts a reprint must keep.
reason: Contracts: prune previews unless --yes and re-checks every branch live before DELETE (skip default/protected, skip when live activity is recent or no activity timestamp exists, treat 404 as gone, report per-branch status); preview up is idempotent by branch name, waits for its create operations (and, after a 409, the other run's) before returning a connection string, and infers database/role; wait walks the full operation history once (Neon ignores branch filters), then re-checks tracked operations by ID plus new head operations, and only fails on operations it saw running or that started during the wait; usage commands choose consumption history or sync snapshots per project, because consumption history is plan-gated; storage ranking uses one measurement (snapshot bytes) because history reports byte-months.
validated_outcome: Provider handler tests exercise the adapter and lifecycle behavior; live proof remains blocked by environment.
